# opportunitydesk.org API

Scrape grant opportunities from Opportunity Desk, including grant details such as deadlines, eligible countries, eligible applicants, grant amounts, and application URLs.

## Install / import

```python
from parse_apis.opportunitydesk_org_api import OpportunityDesk
```

## Operations

Call these on the client's collection accessors (e.g. `client.<collection>.<op>(…)`) or via active-record navigation on returned objects — see [`example.py`](./example.py) for the exact call spelling. List operations return a lazy `Paginator`.

| Call | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `client.grants.get(slug: Optional[str] = None)` | `Grant` | Get detailed information about a specific grant by its slug or numeric ID. Parses the grant post content to extract structured fields: deadline, eligible countries, eligible applicants, grant amount, per-sector/individual amount details, and the external application URL. Provide either slug (from list_grants results) or id. |
| `grantsummary.details()` | `Grant` | Get detailed information about a specific grant by its slug or numeric ID. Parses the grant post content to extract structured fields: deadline, eligible countries, eligible applicants, grant amount, per-sector/individual amount details, and the external application URL. Provide either slug (from list_grants results) or id. |
| `client.grant_summaries.list(per_page: Optional[int] = None, search: Optional[str] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None, max_fetches: int = 1000)` | `Paginator[GrantSummary]` | List grant opportunities from Opportunity Desk with optional search filtering and pagination. Returns grant summaries including title, date, link, and excerpt. Pagination is controlled by page and per_page parameters. Pagination is handled by the returned iterator; page/cursor parameters are not exposed. |

## Errors

| Error | Raised when | Carries |
|---|---|---|
| `GrantNotFound` | The requested grant slug or ID does not match any grant | — |

Runtime errors (`RateLimitError`, `UpstreamError`, `PaginationLimitError`, …) are importable from `parse_apis` and can occur on any call.
